tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search the published Personalized Gifts Guide catalog (Zazzle products, Amazon bundle picks and related guides or bundles) by free text and/or structured filters: recipient, occasion, product type, source. Returns title, product type, the site page, an image (Zazzle), and the already-correct Zazzle

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Fetch a published guide or bundle page, including Black Friday, Amazon bundle pages, under-$ guides, and GTA 6 gear. Returns the page URL, summary, and a capped list of already-published product links.

tools.name: list_bots
tools.description: List the live public helper bots from the site's bots.json (name, help, triggers, and share URL).

tools.name: order_by_dates
tools.description: Return the 2026 holiday send-by calendar from the site, including USPS Christmas mail-by dates, Hanukkah dates, FAQs, and the public ICS URL.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_gifts" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Search the published Personalized Gifts Guide catalog (Zazzle products, Amazon bundle picks and related guides or bundles) by free text and/or structured filter…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_gifts, get_guide, list_bots · Public sink: list_bots, order_by_dates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_gifts, get_guide, list_bots · Public sink: list_bots, order_by_dates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
